description.value: Street Hawker is a halal-certified smashed burger and fried chicken fast-food joint in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, known for creative fusion riffs like Filipino adobo chicken sandos, kimchi burgers, and palabok poutine. All beef is 100% Canadian and chicken is hormone-free farm-fed, with an explicit commitment to plant-based options. Online ordering and pickup are available, making it a quick and filling stop for cyclists passing through the Main Street corridor.
